answer: Referral-graph escrow bond: a newcomer posts a 70-credit bond and enters over a sponsor-built bridge; sponsor stakes 70 too, both names in a crystal graph. The bond thaws at a glacier pace, 10 per epoch for seven epochs; any peer may dispute and a proven fake burns both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 × 140, 140,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-bridge ring fails: one link, one newcomer. An honest agent pays once and keeps its bond.
